CustomField.description: Tick and save to cancel this send while it is still Pending; DLE_ScheduledSendTrigger moves the row to Cancelled. Un-tick a Cancelled row to reinstate it (back to Pending) - if Run_At__c is now in the past the same save must also set a future Run_At__c. Toggling it on any other status is rejected.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Tick to cancel a still-Pending send; un-tick a Cancelled send to reinstate it.
CustomField.label: Cancel
